model.variant: Swift, not the non-Swift Huihui recipe

method.workload: Served deterministic archive recall with six markers at 1%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 95% depth.
method.sampling: One cold-prefix request per context checkpoint; values rounded as supplied in the updated measurement log.
method.token_counting: The prompt-token column is the tokenizer-sized request; the server prompt timer reports 40 fewer processed tokens.
method.decode_metric: Native server predicted_per_second: (generated tokens - 1) / decode seconds; excludes prompt processing and request overhead.
method.recall_metric: Correctly recovered synthetic marker values, not a general capability score.

limitations: These measurements use the Swift artifact and must not be represented as measurements of the non-Swift Huihui checkpoint.
The repetitive recall workload has high draft acceptance; ordinary prose can be much slower.
A prior 260,000-token repeat measured 275.73 tok/s; these are individual observations, not a universal speed guarantee.
